feeds.title: Derek's Music Blog » New Wave
feeds.description: Derek's Music Blog is the music blog where music matters. The music blog has a section covering all the information about the new wave music culture including, new releases, music, and artist informative articles, bands, announcements, and more.

feeds.title: Music For The Misfits » New Wave
feeds.description: Hi Misfits, we're here for you and the bands you like. The music for the Misfits is a music blog majorly covering information about the band and its fans. Their blog features articles on New Wave music culture, least news, concerts & event announcements, singles, albums, and more.

feeds.title: Systems of Romance Blog » New Wave
feeds.description: Systems of Romance was created in mid-2007 to serve as a dumping ground for all great things coldwave, minimal synth, post-punk, synthpunk, industrial, synthpop, and various other combinations of these styles. Their blog covers New Wave and features articles on singles, albums, bands, events and more.

feeds.title: No New Wave No Fun
feeds.description: No New Wave No Fun is a new age music blog that features New wave music, the latest updates from the industry, single & album reviews, new releases.

feeds.title: New Wave Radio Blog
feeds.description: New Wave Radio Blog is a one-stop place for all your new wave music needs. Follow the blog to stay updated about the latest news from the industry, the charts, top music, concerts, shows, events, features, and more.

feeds.title: Obscure Sound » New Wave
feeds.description: Obscure Sound is an Indie music blog featuring quality, emerging artists through streaming audio and in-depth reviews. Their mission is to provide music fans with the latest and greatest music from promising artists..Thier blog features New Wave music, the latest releases, albums, and single reviews.

feeds.title: Stamp The Wax » New Wave/Experimental
feeds.description: Stamp The Wax began in 2011, by two friends who were bored with their degrees and wanted somewhere to talk about the music they love. Six years later, their team and ambitions have grown but nothing's changed. Whether it's through written content, mixes, videos, radio shows, and events, you will only find music that we think you should be listening to. Follow the blog to learn more about the latest music, new releases, reviews and more.
